name: Board Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  Meeting of the
  Westlake Village Community Foundation

  Westlake Village City Hall
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village

  Tuesday, June 28, 2022 12:30 p.m.
  Written comments may be sent to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org
  no later than 9:00 a.m. on Tuesday, June 28, 2022. Written comments will be summarized
  during the meeting.

  Due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, Westlake Village Community Foundation Board
Members and staff are participating in this meeting via teleconference pursuant to Government
  Code Section 54953(e).

  In the interest of maintaining appropriate social distancing, a physical location is not being
 provided for the public to attend or comment. Members of the public may observe the meeting
 telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service, and may offer
  comment in real time, with the following steps:

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89274077136
  Webinar ID: 892 7407 7136
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16699009128,,89274077136# or +12532158782,,89274077136#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 900 9128 or +1 253 215 8782 or +1 346 248 7799 or +1 301 715 8592

Teleconference participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Chair.
  In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services,
  please call the City at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

  Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
  distributed by the Board Members less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for public
  inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business hours.
 CALL TO ORDER:  12:30 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Foundation Members Brutzkus, Croner, Honig, Halpern and
  McSweeney

PUBLIC COMMENTS:  Members of the public may address the Administrative Committee. Please
observe the time limit of three minutes. Members of the public may offer comment telephonically or
otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options as list on Page 1 of this agenda.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Approval of the February 2, 2022 and April 26, 2022 Meeting Minutes

DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  1. Receive and Approve Grant Acceptance from the Gene Haas Foundation.
  2. Selection of Awardees and Amounts for the Foundation’s 2022 Scholarship
  Program.
  3. Financial Update.
  4. Consideration of Request to Support Cultural Activities and Programs in
  conjunction with the July 4th City event.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, June 23, 2022 at 3:00 p.m. on the City website and in the Posting
Board at City Hall.
